messages.subject: Project Indigo - COMPLETED - executed Licence
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Pleased to confirm Project Indigo has completed today. The executed Patent and Know-How Licence Agreement is attached, together with the completion checklist. The first upfront instalment of £2,000,000 is due on today's date. Hartington IP will deal with recordal of the licence at the relevant patent offices.

Congratulations to both teams.

Best wishes,
Elena

Elena Marchetti | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
